sections.content: EMPLOYMENT RIGHTS

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: SECTION 94

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: RIGHT NOT TO BE UNFAIRLY DISMISSED

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: An employee has the right not to be subjected to unfair dismissal by his employer.

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: SECTION 95

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: REMEDY FOR UNFAIR DISMISSAL

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (1) Where a tribunal finds that a person has been unfairly dismissed, the tribunal shall make such order as it considers just and equitable having regard to the loss sustained by the complainant in co...

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (2) An order under subsection (1) may require the employer to—

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (a) pay the complainant compensation of such amount as the tribunal determines; or

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (b) reinstate the complainant in his former employment; or

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (c) re-engage the complainant in employment which is, so far as is practicable, similar to the former employment of the complainant.

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: SECTION 86

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: NOTICE PERIOD

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (1) The minimum period of notice which may be given by an employer to terminate an employee's contract of employment is—

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (a) one week, if the employee has been continuously employed for one month or more but less than two years;

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (b) two weeks, if the employee has been continuously employed for two years or more but less than five years;

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (c) one week for each year of continuous employment, if the employee has been continuously employed for five years or more but less than twelve years;

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (d) twelve weeks, if the employee has been continuously employed for twelve years or more.

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: CHAPTER 2

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: HEALTH AND SAFETY

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: SECTION 2

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: GENERAL DUTIES OF EMPLOYERS TO EMPLOYEES

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: It shall be the duty of every employer to ensure, so far as is reasonably practicable, the health, safety and welfare at work of all his employees.
